meta.name: ai-search-optimization
meta.description: Optimizes for AI assistants and AI-generated answers — being retrievable, being cited, and being represented accurately when a model answers on your behalf. Use this when traffic is shifting from links to AI answers, when a brand is misrepresented or absent in AI responses, when planning content for retrieval rather than ranking, or when deciding how AI search changes an existing SEO program.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让品牌在AI回答里更易被找到和准确引用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果品牌流量正从点击转向AI生成回答
copy.tagline_en: Optimize your brand's presence in AI-generated answers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your brand's traffic is shifting from links to AI-generated answers

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会用“被引用而非被点击”的标准优化内容：建议在标题首句直接答、用具体事实、让段落自包含、保持事实一致、维护权威页面，并改用引用次数等指标衡量。
howto.when: 当你说流量从链接转向AI答案、品牌在AI回应中缺失或被歪曲、为检索而非排名规划内容等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个页面，让它更容易被AI引用。
say.note: Claude会按引用原则提出改写建议。

say.text: 模拟几个AI助手，看看它们怎么描述我们公司。
say.note: 会审计回答，找出错误并追踪来源。

say.text: 把定价和对比页改写成AI直接能引用的版本。
say.note: 保留事实，按自包含原则重写。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude optimizes for AI citation: answer first under each heading, self-contained passages, checkable facts, consistent info, canonical pages, and measure via citations and branded search.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users mention traffic shifting from links to AI answers, a brand misrepresented in AI replies, content planned for retrieval not ranking, or how AI changes current SEO.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this page to be more easily cited by AI.
say_en.note: Claude will apply quote-friendly writing rules.

say_en.text: Ask several AI assistants what they say about our company and find errors.
say_en.note: Simulates an audit tracing mistakes to sources.

say_en.text: Rewrite the pricing and comparison page in an AI-quotable format.
say_en.note: Keeps facts intact and sections self-contained.
